Only full fill-ups close an interval; partial fill-ups in between count towards it. The average is the sum of the litres over the sum of the kilometres.

Chain care, service, tires: when maintenance is due

After how many kilometres a maintenance is due. Without an interval there is no reminder. The logbook shows “due in N km” from the last entry of the kind, counted with the estimated odometer reading (the last reading in the log plus the kilometres counted by GPS).
